definitions.explanation: A pure substance consisting of atoms that all have the same number of protons; one of the fundamental building blocks of matter.

examples.japanese: {水素|すいそ}は{元素|げんそ}だ。
{元素|げんそ}{記号|きごう}を{覚|おぼ}える。
{周期表|しゅうきひょう}には118の{元素|げんそ}がある。

notes:
{元素|げんそ} refers specifically to chemical elements — the fundamental substances that cannot be broken down further by chemical means.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {元素|げんそ}{記号|きごう}: element symbol (e.g., H, O, Fe)
- {元素|げんそ}{周期表|しゅうきひょう}: periodic table of elements
- {放射性|ほうしゃせい}{元素|げんそ}: radioactive element
- {希土類|きどるい}{元素|げんそ}: rare earth element
- {微量|びりょう}{元素|げんそ}: trace element

CONTRAST WITH {要素|ようそ}:
{元素|げんそ} is strictly a chemistry term. {要素|ようそ} means 'element' in the general sense of a component or factor (e.g., {成功|せいこう}の{要素|ようそ} = elements of success).

RELATED TERMS:
- {原子|げんし}: atom
- {分子|ぶんし}: molecule
- {化合物|かごうぶつ}: compound
